escena: SCENE (documentary, a client workshop in a bright meeting room, the team maps the customer journey): two pairs of hands and one face at the edge of the frame, caught at the exact moment a strategist moves a large paper card from one column to another on a white wall covered with a grid of cards and hand-drawn arrows; bright daylight from a window on the right rakes across the wall so the edges of the cards cast small crisp shadows. Plain clothes in white and olive. One plain azure-blue (#0375DB) marker in a hand carries the only blue. 50mm f/2.8. Nobody looks at the lens. Cards carry only tiny illegible handwriting, unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the pale edge of the meeting table right at the lens, dissolved into blur
